code: library(irtexplorer)  # category response curves of a polytomous item theta <- seq(-6, 6, by = 0.1) plot_category_curves(theta, prob_gpcm(theta, a = 1.5), "Generalized Partial Credit Model") plot_category_curves(theta, prob_grm(theta, b = c(-1.5, 0, 1.5)), "Graded Response Model")  # an item that measures mostly the first of two abilities grid <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 50) a <- c(2, 0.5) plot_mirt_contour(grid, grid, prob_mirt(grid, grid, a = a), level = 0.5, arrow = item_vector(a))  # Newton-Raphson steps towards the maximum likelihood estimate of ability nr <- newton_raphson_rasch(response_pattern(2), iterations = 5) nr$steps[, c("start", "end")] plot_newton_raphson(nr)  # EAP and MAP estimates with 40 quadrature points estimate <- eap_map(response_pattern(2), quadrature = 40) c(EAP = estimate$eap, MAP = estimate$map) plot_eap_combined(estimate)
